title: My Tho in a day
summary: Hủ tiếu, the morning boat to Thới Sơn, Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, and the statue in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng. The pagoda visit is 120 minutes. The bowl, the boat, and the statue have no timed visit. The boat fare is check on arrival.

stops.name: Hu tieu My Tho
stops.note: Breakfast, lunch, or supper. Dry, or with the broth. No page prints how long the bowl takes. The 40 minutes are not a published duration. The price is check on arrival.

stops.name: Thoi Son islet
stops.note: Morning boat from 01 Hoàng Sa, then a sampan in the nipa. The 180 minutes are not a published duration. The fare is check on arrival.

stops.name: Vinh Trang Pagoda
stops.note: 120 minutes. The gate is free. Confirm it on arrival. The pier is 1.96 km away. The boat leaves from that pier.

stops.name: Thu Khoa Huan statue
stops.note: The pin of the embankment, late afternoon. The dossier calls it a few minutes, not a clock. The 15 minutes are not a published duration. The fee is check on arrival.

seoTitle: My Tho in a day — bowl, pagoda, embankment
seoDescription: A My Tho day: hủ tiếu, the morning boat to Thoi Son, 120 minutes at Vinh Trang, and the statue on the embankment. Boat fare and the bowl price are check on arrival.
